paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better

model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the change in "Informativeness" across four discrete points on the x-axis, labeled 0 through 4, for two methods: "0-CoT" and "CoRe". The y-axis, labeled "Informativeness", ranges from 0.910 to 0.960 and uses a linear scale. The "0-CoT" method is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, starting at an informativeness value of 0.960 at x=0 and decreasing to 0.910 at x=4. The "CoRe" method is represented by an orange solid line with triangular markers, also starting at 0.960 at x=0 and decreasing to 0.910 at x=4. Both lines show a consistent downward trend across the entire range of the x-axis, with no intermediate peaks or plateaus. The two lines begin at the same point and converge at the end point, with the "0-CoT" line consistently positioned slightly above the "CoRe" line at every intermediate x-value.
